visualizationDefinition: Requests the QASM for the two-qubit Deutsch circuit, showing the oracle call and measurement that separates constant vs. balanced functions in one query for Q.js rendering.

solver.solverDefinition: This is a classical solver for the Deutsch Problem which simply tries both inputs to f(x) and computes whether they are the same (constant) or different (balanced)
solver.source: Deutsch, David. 1985. Quantum theory, the Church-Turing principle and the universal quantum computer. Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A40097-117
